scenario: The ego vehicle travels on a multi-lane road when a black car makes an illegal U-turn from the opposite direction, followed by a white car also making a U-turn from a side road.

ego.behavior: The car travels straight forward along its lane and decelerates to avoid collisions with vehicles making U-turns.

adversarials.behavior: The black car makes a U-turn from the opposite direction across double yellow lines, entering the ego's lane.
The white car makes a U-turn from a side road on the right, entering the road ahead of the ego vehicle.

requirements_and_restrictions: The ego vehicle must maintain safe following distance and react to unexpected U-turn maneuvers from both directions; scenario terminates once the ego has passed both U-turning vehicles.

road_side_structures.position: Positioned along the right side of the road among the trees.
